# VidhiCorp Legal Chambers — Full Reference

> This file is the expanded companion to /llms.txt, for AI systems that fetch a single document rather than crawling multiple pages. ## Firm identity
- Legal name: VidhiCorp Legal Chambers. Type: corporate, commercial and dispute resolution law firm (independent chambers), Gurugram, India.
- Founder & Managing Partner: Jankee Ballabh Pandey — 20+ years across in-house counsel roles (Head of Legal & Integrity Officer, Atotech Group; earlier at Unilever, Whirlpool, Trident) and courtroom practice before the District Court Delhi, Central Administrative Tribunal, Delhi High Court and Supreme Court of India. Awards: Best Leading Lawyers 2022; Top 10 General Counsel 2022.
- Co-Founder & Partner: Sanjulata Pandey — family and personal legal matters, matrimonial disputes, counselling, interviewing and advisory for individuals.
- Location: I-001, Maple Crescent, C-Block, Sushant Lok 1, Sector 43, Gurugram, Haryana 122009, India. Serving Delhi NCR, Mumbai and businesses across India.
- Phone: +91 98102 01992 / +91 99535 11555 / +91 83683 39487. Email: jankee@vidhicorplegal.com, info@vidhicorplegal.com.
- Regulatory/ethical note: in accordance with the Bar Council of India's Rules on advertising by advocates, the firm does not solicit work; this site is informational only.

## Practice areas (15)
Corporate & Commercial Advisory; Transactions & Strategic Advisory; Contracts & Agreements; Joint Ventures; Mergers & Acquisitions; Cross-Border Transactions; Funding & Investments; Employment, HR & POSH; Compliance & Regulatory Support; Dispute Resolution & Arbitration; Due Diligence; Intellectual Property Rights; Real Estate & Property Matters; Private Client & Family Matters; Legal Opinions.
